notes.title: Update Notes for March 23rd
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We just uploaded a small patch with some fixes. Here is a list of changes for this patch:

- Fixed an issue with order generation for some devices.
- Decreased the cost of sandblasting.
- Fixed a bug with the item shop.
- Fixed an issue that made the delivery boxes stay when you canceled an order.
- Improved the way the game displays the progress of sandblasting.
